name: dsh-ops-codex
description: Bounded dsh-ops files, REA artifacts, and Codex maintenance workflows with a 20k output ceiling.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded files, REA artifacts, and maintenance
interface.longDescription: Bridges the dsh-ops 0.4.4 native worker and a pinned REA 6.8.0 gateway to Codex. It exposes bounded file and document operations, nine REA entry operations through a compact fixed gateway, read-only scope auditing, and maintenance workflows. Large downstream results are saved locally and returned as bounded previews; Codex approvals remain authoritative.
defaultPrompt: Map this repository with bounded dsh-ops file facts.
Find these symbols with summary-first dsh-ops search.
Inspect this shipped artifact with the bounded REA gateway.
Audit this Codex installation without bypassing approvals.
Inspect or edit this large project without flooding context.
